item.title: Thiel's SECRET Dialog leak: 113 elites exposed [June 2026]
item.description: This episode breaks down a series of major security lapses. We start with the massive leak of Peter Thiel and Auren Hoffman's ultra-secret 'Dialog' network, founded 20 years ago [1, 2]. Security researcher maia arson crimew exposed profiles of 113 elites—including Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Sen. Ted Cruz, and actor Josh Brolin—revealing private emails, phone numbers, and political leanings [3-5]. Next, we analyze iRhythm's SEC filing confirming a cyberattack where hackers stole patient health information and demanded a ransom [6, 7]. We also examine Nintendo's statement on a data leak involving third-party employee survey service TinyPulse [8], and the $3.3 million class action settlement for the 2025 Mt. Baker Imaging data breach [9, 10].

item.title: Sha'Carri Richardson FINALLY avoids 1 jail term
item.description: Olympic sprinter Sha'Carri Richardson dodged a Florida jail cell despite treating State Road 429 like a private Olympic track. She pled no contest to driving 104 mph and dangerously tailgating civilian motorists. Experiencing a driver blowing past you at that speed feels like getting your car doors ripped off by a low-flying jet during a morning commute. She walked away with a $500 fine and an 8-hour driving class. Florida's strict 2025 super speeder law bows to gold medalists.
